author: CNET
description:
Fitbit’s first new fitness tracker with a display in years, the Fitbit Edge has a useful touchscreen for checking your stats mid-workout and keeping up with your notifications. It slots neatly into the middle of Google’s current lineup, between the Fitbit Air and the Pixel Watch 5. We take a look at the Edge to see if it’s the right tracker for you.
